meaning: Engulf weather horoscope: readings for each day, from the numbers below them.
lead: 12 days out: ensembles only. Read the shares as leanings, not plans.

days.about: arrival, setting up camp, the roads in
lines: 82 runs from ECMWF ENS, NOAA GEFS. Afternoon near 70°F (the week's usual is 72°F); morning low near 50°F (usual 45°F).
Rain of 0.1 in or more: about 1 run in 10 (in past years, 14% of these days).
A night at 40°F or colder: fewer than 1 run in 10.
